# Dume.ai Documentation

Dume.ai is an AI executive assistant you talk to like a person. It reads your inbox, calendar, and docs, drafts replies, files tickets, and runs recurring routines on a schedule — from the web app, the Cowork desktop app, or WhatsApp.

## Getting Started
- [Introduction](/index) - Overview of Dume.ai and quick start guide
- [Personalization](/getting-started/personalisation) - Customize your AI assistant
- [Connect Tools](/getting-started/connect-your-first-tool) - Link your first integration
- [Chat Interface](/getting-started/chat-interface) - Learn to communicate with your AI assistant

## Integrations
- [Gmail](/integrations/gmail) - Email summarization, triage, search, and drafting
- [Google Calendar](/integrations/calendar) - Scheduling and meeting management
- [Google Docs](/integrations/google_docs) - Document creation and editing
- [Google Sheets](/integrations/google_sheets) - Spreadsheet management
- [Google Drive](/integrations/google-drive) - File search and storage
- [GitHub](/integrations/github) - Repository management and PR reviews
- Slack - Tool access for messages and channels (dedicated page coming in the integrations rewrite)
- [Notion](/integrations/notion) - Knowledge base management
- [Microsoft 365](/integrations/microsoft_365) - Outlook and Office document access
- [MCP Servers](/integrations/mcp/overview) - Connect any custom MCP server by URL

## Tools
- [Artifacts](/tools/artifacts) - Create and manage documents, spreadsheets, code, and images
- [Charts](/tools/charts) - Interactive data visualization and chart creation
- [Web Search](/tools/web-search) - AI-powered internet research tools
- [Web Scraper](/tools/web-scraper) - Intelligent data extraction from websites
- [People Search](/tools/people-search) - Professional contact discovery
- [Notifications](/tools/notification) - Automated email alerts and notifications

## Key Features
- **Real integrations**: Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Drive, GitHub, Slack, Notion, Microsoft 365, plus any custom MCP server
- **Routines**: schedule a recurring instruction and Dume runs it on its own, locally or in the cloud
- **Natural language interface**: no commands to memorize, just ask
- **WhatsApp and phone**: message or call Dume directly, no app required
- **Cross-platform**: web app and Cowork desktop app share the same experience

## Common Use Cases
- Email management and drafting
- Calendar scheduling and meeting coordination
- Document creation and editing
- Project management and task tracking
- Data analysis and visualization
- Research and information gathering
- Recurring reports and daily briefings

For comprehensive documentation and tutorials, visit https://docs.dume.ai
